description: MirrorBuddy Beta - monitoring gaps. Unsupported funnel, budget, abuse and resource usage panels retired in #1076; missing telemetry is not zero.

options.content: Legacy trial/invite funnel, conversion, budget and abuse panels were retired: their 22 metric names had no producers. Four additional resource usage panels (13, 14, 15, 17) queried trial_voice_seconds_total, trial_tool_calls_total and trial_chats_total without producers and were removed. These three unsupported dashboard-only query names are additional monitoring gaps, not part of the 22 source names removed. Telemetry is unavailable, not zero or healthy. Budget, abuse, conversion-drop and invite-backlog alerts were also removed from the repository configuration. Independent DB-backed business metrics remain in the main dashboard; they are not equivalent replacements for these alerts. See docs/operations/SLI-SLO.md (#1076) for the migration and monitoring gaps.

title: MirrorBuddy Beta Dashboard
